sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费者产品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，获取nytimes.com/subscribe上的特别优惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的Rachel Abrams，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: As the federal government reverses course on renewable energy projects and other policies related to climate change, states, cities, and local groups are stepping into the breach.
sentences.zh: 随着联邦政府在可再生能源项目及其他气候变化相关政策上改变方针，各州、各市和地方团体正在填补这一空白。

sentences.en: Today, my colleagues Cara Buckley and Katrin Einhorn on their project to document small but significant efforts to solve climate and environmental problems in every state in
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事Cara Buckley和Katrin Einhorn将介绍她们的项目，该项目旨在记录全国各州为解决气候和环境问题所做的虽小但意义重大的努力。

sentences.en: the country.
sentences.zh: 全国。

sentences.en: It's Friday, January 2nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月2日，星期五。

sentences.en: Katrin, Happy New Year.
sentences.zh: Katrin，新年快乐。

sentences.en: Happy New Year.
sentences.zh: 新年快乐。

sentences.en: Happy New Year.
sentences.zh: 新年快乐。

sentences.en: The two of you just completed this really big and ambitious series, 50 states, 50 fixes.
sentences.zh: 你们俩刚刚完成了这个非常宏大且雄心勃勃的系列报道，“50个州，50个解决方案”。

sentences.en: And I have to say, it is more, let's say, optimistic than the types of stories we typically read in our august pages.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，这比我们通常在这些权威版面上读到的报道要乐观得多。

sentences.en: So I want to talk about the origin of this.
sentences.zh: 所以我想谈谈这个系列的起源。

sentences.en: Tell me how this series started.
sentences.zh: 告诉我这个系列是怎么开始的。

sentences.en: Cara, I'm going to start with you.
sentences.zh: Cara，我先从你开始。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So to answer your question, I have to go back in time.
sentences.zh: 回答你的问题，我得回顾一下过去。

sentences.en: I used to be a culture reporter at the paper.
sentences.zh: 我以前是报社的文化记者。

sentences.en: I was interviewing movie stars.
sentences.zh: 我当时在采访电影明星。

sentences.en: I was reporting on things like Me Too.
sentences.zh: 我报道过像“我也是”（Me Too）这样的事件。

sentences.en: But throughout it all, especially in the late 2010s, I was finding it really hard to process
sentences.zh: 但在整个过程中，特别是在2010年代末，我发现自己真的很难消化

sentences.en: all the negative climate news we were hearing about, the planet overheating, species crashing, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 我们听到的所有关于气候的负面新闻，比如地球过热、物种灭绝等等。

sentences.en: You were having a personal struggle.
sentences.zh: 你当时正经历个人的挣扎。

sentences.en: I was having a personal struggle.
sentences.zh: 我确实在经历个人的挣扎。

sentences.en: And I just really didn't understand how people were coping with it.
sentences.zh: 我真的不明白人们是如何应对这些的。

sentences.en: And I thought, well, what can we do?
sentences.zh: 我想，我们能做些什么呢？

sentences.en: What can I do?
sentences.zh: 我能做些什么？

sentences.en: And so I thought, maybe I can report this out, but in a way that focused on all these efforts that people were doing to try and reverse climate change, you know, things that were
sentences.zh: 于是我想，也许我可以报道这些，但要专注于人们为试图扭转气候变化所做的所有努力，你知道，那些

sentences.en: having an impact, because a lot of things can have an impact.
sentences.zh: 能产生影响的事情，因为很多事情都能产生影响。

sentences.en: So in 2021, I joined the Climate Desk.
sentences.zh: 所以2021年，我加入了气候报道组。

sentences.en: And my focus from the start was on people that were doing things in their communities that were working.
sentences.zh: 从一开始，我的重点就是那些在社区里做着有效工作的人们。

sentences.en: Which is kind of unusual in the sense that we normally think of journalism as writing about problems, not about solutions.
sentences.zh: 这有点不同寻常，因为我们通常认为新闻报道是写问题，而不是写解决方案。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So this kind of beat is kind of looking at, you know, not the plane crashes, but the planes that are not only successfully landing, but doing it really well.
sentences.zh: 所以这个报道方向有点像是在观察，你知道，不是看飞机失事，而是看那些不仅成功着陆，而且着陆得非常漂亮的飞机。

sentences.en: An early story I did was about people taking over old golf courses and rewilding them, which was helping biodiversity.
sentences.zh: 我早期做过的一个报道是关于人们接管旧高尔夫球场并进行生态修复，这有助于生物多样性。

sentences.en: I did stories about roundabouts in Carmel, Indiana, which are the most sustainable types of intersections and reduce emissions.
sentences.zh: 我报道过印第安纳州卡梅尔市的环岛，它们是最可持续的交叉路口类型，能减少排放。

sentences.en: And it was out of that reporting that I did over three years, I thought, there's going to be a solution in every state.
sentences.zh: 正是基于我三年来的报道，我想，每个州一定都有一个解决方案。

sentences.en: I was hearing about some of them, and I thought, let's set ourselves a challenge and also go
sentences.zh: 我听说过其中一些，我想，让我们给自己定个挑战，去

sentences.en: and find out a distinct climate or environmental success story in each one of the 50 states.
sentences.zh: 找出50个州中每一个州独特的气候或环境成功故事。

sentences.en: And Katrin, I remember us talking a few years ago, right after you joined the Climate and the Environment Desk.
sentences.zh: Katrin，我记得几年前我们谈过，就在你加入气候与环境报道组之后。

sentences.en: And I think you were also kind of concerned about how to write about this topic in a way that wouldn't always hit that same note of existential dread that Cara is talking about.
sentences.zh: 我想你当时也很担心如何以一种不会总是触及Cara所说的那种存在主义恐惧的方式来撰写这个主题。

sentences.en: Yeah, I remember setting a goal for myself that I would include a solution in the story somewhere, even if it was a little bit at the bottom.
sentences.zh: 是的，我记得我给自己定了一个目标，无论如何都要在报道中加入一个解决方案，哪怕只是在文末提一下。

sentences.en: I would at least say what the solution was in every story that I wrote.
sentences.zh: 我写的每一篇报道，至少都会说明解决方案是什么。

sentences.en: I don't know if I totally succeeded, but I tried.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我是否完全成功了，但我尝试过。

sentences.en: But I came to the Climate Desk to cover biodiversity.
sentences.zh: 但我加入气候报道组是为了报道生物多样性。

sentences.en: So wildlife and ecosystems, I cover extinction, right?
sentences.zh: 也就是野生动物和生态系统，我报道的是灭绝，对吧？

sentences.en: So when I first heard about Cara's series, it was in January 2025 after the election, of course.
sentences.zh: 所以当我第一次听说Cara的系列报道时，那是在2025年1月，选举之后，当然。

sentences.en: And I was really excited about it because we knew that President Trump was going to be dismantling a lot of climate policy, environmental policy, environmental regulation.
sentences.zh: 我对此感到非常兴奋，因为我们知道特朗普总统将要拆解许多气候政策、环境政策和环境法规。

sentences.en: I was so interested to focus on the things that people will still be doing, are doing, have
sentences.zh: 我非常有兴趣关注人们仍然在做、正在做、已经

sentences.en: been doing to address things at the state, local, tribal levels, separately from the federal government.
sentences.zh: 在做的事情，以在州、地方、部落层面解决问题，与联邦政府分开。

sentences.en: I was really drawn to this series because it seemed like that's where a lot of the action was going to be happening.
sentences.zh: 我真的被这个系列吸引了，因为看起来很多行动都将发生在那里。

sentences.en: So when you set out to do this series, what was the mandate?
sentences.zh: 那么，当你们着手做这个系列时，任务是什么？

sentences.en: We wanted win, win, wins.
sentences.zh: 我们想要多赢。

sentences.en: Multiple wins.
sentences.zh: 多重胜利。

sentences.en: Multiple wins.
sentences.zh: 多重胜利。

sentences.en: So it's not just resilience.
sentences.zh: 所以不仅仅是韧性。

sentences.en: It's not just adaptation.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是适应。

sentences.en: It's doing things that are reducing greenhouse gas emissions, that are making ecosystems healthier, that are helping restore imperiled species.
sentences.zh: 而是要做那些能减少温室气体排放、使生态系统更健康、帮助恢复濒危物种的事情。

sentences.en: So we want it at the same time helping human health and saving people money.
sentences.zh: 所以我们希望它同时能改善人类健康并为人们省钱。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In a way, basically, you're showing the interconnectedness of our climate to our economy, to our health with this series, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 从某种程度上说，听起来你们通过这个系列展示了我们的气候与经济、健康之间的相互联系。

sentences.en: Precisely.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: So at this point, you have reported from all 50 states.
sentences.zh: 那么现在，你们已经报道了所有50个州。

sentences.en: Congratulations.
sentences.zh: 恭喜。

sentences.en: You have traversed the country.
sentences.zh: 你们走遍了全国。

sentences.en: Not just us, to be fair.
sentences.zh: 公平地说，不仅仅是我们。

sentences.en: It wasn't just the two of us.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是我们俩。

sentences.en: We had, there was a whole team of people that worked really hard on this series, including colleagues on our desk and on national.
sentences.zh: 我们有一个团队，整个团队的人都在为这个系列努力工作，包括我们报道组和全国组的同事。

sentences.en: 50 plus photographers.
sentences.zh: 50多位摄影师。

sentences.en: 50 plus photographers and 13 reporters.
sentences.zh: 50多位摄影师和13名记者。

sentences.en: Okay, that is cool.
sentences.zh: 好的，那太酷了。

sentences.en: I want to talk about some of those stories.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈其中一些故事。

sentences.en: So let's start with each of you telling me about one that really stood out to you, maybe because it had that multiple win or downstream effects that you mentioned.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们从你们每个人讲述一个真正让你们印象深刻的故事开始，也许是因为它有你提到的那种多重胜利或下游效应。

sentences.en: Cara, let's start with you.
sentences.zh: Cara，我们从你开始。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: So one of the stories that really popped for me was about a funeral director in northwest
sentences.zh: 所以，让我印象特别深刻的一个故事是关于密苏里州西北部的一位殡仪馆馆长。

sentences.en: Missouri.
sentences.zh: 密苏里州。

sentences.en: He lived in one of the most rural counties in the state.
sentences.zh: 他住在这个州最偏远的县之一。

sentences.en: His name was Eric Chamberlain.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫Eric Chamberlain。

sentences.en: He runs a family funeral business.
sentences.zh: 他经营着一家家族殡葬企业。

sentences.en: And he had been worrying for a long time about how his small town was getting smaller.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，他一直担心他的小镇正在变得越来越小。

sentences.en: People were moving away and they weren't coming back.
sentences.zh: 人们搬走了，而且再也没有回来。

sentences.en: And he was just trying to figure out, like, how could he help?
sentences.zh: 他只是在想，他能帮上什么忙吗？

sentences.en: Was there anything to reverse the economic misfortunes of the town?
sentences.zh: 有什么办法能扭转小镇的经济困境吗？

sentences.en: And he was at work one day driving a hearse.
sentences.zh: 有一天他在工作，开着灵车。

sentences.en: He was over the border in Iowa.
sentences.zh: 他当时在爱荷华州的边境那边。

sentences.en: And he saw these giant white blades of a wind turbine.
sentences.zh: 他看到了风力涡轮机巨大的白色叶片。

sentences.en: He'd never seen them before.
sentences.zh: 他以前从未见过。

sentences.en: He wanted to pull over, but he was leading a funeral procession, so he did not.
sentences.zh: 他想靠边停车，但他当时正在带头送葬队伍，所以没有停。

sentences.en: But he began investigating it.
sentences.zh: 但他开始调查这件事。

sentences.en: And he approached the Department of Natural Resources at the state, and he said, there's a lot of wind in my neck of the woods.
sentences.zh: 他联系了州自然资源部，他说，我住的地方风很大。

sentences.en: Can we maybe look at putting in wind turbines here?
sentences.zh: 我们能不能考虑在这里安装风力涡轮机？

sentences.en: He ended up setting in motion this wind energy project.
sentences.zh: 他最终启动了这个风能项目。

sentences.en: He convinced local farmers to put wind turbines in their fields.
sentences.zh: 他劝说当地农民在他们的田地里安装风力涡轮机。

sentences.en: At first, there were just four.
sentences.zh: 起初只有四个。

sentences.en: And Eric told me he distinctly remembers flipping on the switch in 2008 and watching the town's electricity meter running backwards.
sentences.zh: Eric告诉我，他清楚地记得2008年他合上开关，看着小镇的电表倒着转。

sentences.en: Rockport announced it was the first community in the country to be producing more electricity from wind energy than what it needed.
sentences.zh: Rockport宣布它是全国第一个风能发电量超过自身需求的社区。

sentences.en: And this ended up accruing.
sentences.zh: 这最终积累了起来。

sentences.en: More places in the county started putting up wind turbines.
sentences.zh: 县里更多的地方开始安装风力涡轮机。

sentences.en: Today, there's more than 340.
sentences.zh: 今天，已经有超过340台了。

sentences.en: Throughout the county, it supplies 50 permanent jobs.
sentences.zh: 在整个县，它提供了50个永久性工作岗位。

sentences.en: And really crucially, the town has a tax revenue base from these wind turbines, $6 million a year.
sentences.zh: 而且非常关键的是，小镇从这些风力涡轮机中获得了税收收入，每年600万美元。

sentences.en: It's more than half of the real estate tax revenue for the county.
sentences.zh: 这超过了该县房地产税收入的一半。

sentences.en: And it's supplying extra revenue for farmers who have wind turbines, too.
sentences.zh: 它也为拥有风力涡轮机的农民提供了额外的收入。

sentences.en: It fundamentally changed the economy of this county.
sentences.zh: 它从根本上改变了这个县的经济。

sentences.en: And it all started with one guy.
sentences.zh: 而这一切都始于一个人。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Now, I want to talk about one of the stories that really stood out to me from your series.
sentences.zh: 现在，我想谈谈你们系列中让我印象深刻的一个故事。

sentences.en: I'm a dog person.
sentences.zh: 我是一个爱狗人士。

sentences.en: This is a story where dogs are the heroes.
sentences.zh: 这是一个以狗为英雄的故事。

sentences.en: Can you guess which one I'm talking about?
sentences.zh: 你能猜出我说的是哪一个吗？

sentences.en: Montana.
sentences.zh: 蒙大拿州。

sentences.en: Yes, Montana.
sentences.zh: 是的，蒙大拿州。

sentences.en: You want to explain what it is?
sentences.zh: 你想解释一下它是什么吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的，好的。

sentences.en: I knew that I wanted to write about livestock guardian dogs, you know, which are dogs that are bred to protect livestock from predators like coyotes.
sentences.zh: 我知道我想写关于牲畜护卫犬的内容，你知道，这些狗是为了保护牲畜免受像土狼这样的捕食者侵害而培育的。

sentences.en: Or grizzly bears.
sentences.zh: 或者灰熊。

sentences.en: Or grizzly bears in this case.
sentences.zh: 或者在这种情况下是灰熊。

sentences.en: And in Montana, on the plains of Montana, they have not been dealing with grizzly bears for quite some time because we basically eradicated them from that area.
sentences.zh: 在蒙大拿州，在蒙大拿州的平原上，他们已经很久没有处理过灰熊的问题了，因为我们基本上把它们从那个地区根除了。

sentences.en: You know, they were eradicated from much of the lower 48 states.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它们在下48州的大部分地区都被根除了。

sentences.en: Because they're dangerous?
sentences.zh: 因为它们很危险？

sentences.en: Because they were shot.
sentences.zh: 因为它们被射杀了。

sentences.en: There were a lot of predator campaigns in like the 1800s, early 1900s.
sentences.zh: 在19世纪和20世纪初，有很多针对捕食者的运动。

sentences.en: And then laws were put into place and these predators started rebounding.
sentences.zh: 后来法律出台了，这些捕食者开始回升。

sentences.en: To preserve them, basically, so they wouldn't go extinct.
sentences.zh: 基本上是为了保护它们，以免它们灭绝。

sentences.en: So they wouldn't go extinct, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，以免它们灭绝。

sentences.en: And so these grizzlies have been slowly walking back out to the plains of Montana where there's no real recollection of them in living memory.
sentences.zh: 所以这些灰熊一直在慢慢走回蒙大拿州的平原，那里的人们在有生之年对它们已经没有真正的记忆了。

sentences.en: And one of the things that they've discovered is the wheat and barley farMs.
sentences.zh: 他们发现的一件事是小麦和大麦农场。

sentences.en: And this is like really good eating if you're a grizzly bear.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一只灰熊，这可是非常好的食物。

sentences.en: It's a really nice, easy source of food for them.
sentences.zh: 这对它们来说是一个非常好、非常容易的食物来源。

sentences.en: And so these farmers, they never had bears raiding their orchards.
sentences.zh: 所以这些农民，他们以前从未遇到过熊袭击果园的情况。

sentences.en: Now all of a sudden, there's bears stealing their apples and raiding their grain bins.
sentences.zh: 现在突然之间，有熊在偷他们的苹果，袭击他们的粮仓。

sentences.en: And they're scared to go outside, certainly to let their children play outside.
sentences.zh: 他们害怕出门，更不用说让孩子们在外面玩耍了。

sentences.en: And in Montana, there's a man named Wesley Sarmento, who at the time was the bear manager for the State Wildlife Department.
sentences.zh: 在蒙大拿州，有一个叫Wesley Sarmento的人，他当时是州野生动物部门的熊类经理。

sentences.en: So he's getting all these calls from these farmers who are just desperate because these bears keep showing up on their property.
sentences.zh: 所以他接到了所有这些农民的电话，他们非常绝望，因为这些熊不断出现在他们的土地上。

sentences.en: And Wesley's trying everything to get them to go away, including trapping them.
sentences.zh: Wesley尝试了一切办法让它们离开，包括诱捕它们。

sentences.en: But that's dangerous.
sentences.zh: 但这很危险。

sentences.en: He tried having everyone clean up the grain very well.
sentences.zh: 他尝试让每个人都把谷物清理干净。

sentences.en: But it was impossible because they're on a working farm.
sentences.zh: 但这行不通，因为它们是在一个正在运营的农场里。

sentences.en: He tried electrifying the grain bins, which did work, but it was really bad for the farm workers because it was just really awkward and made working a lot harder.
sentences.zh: 他尝试过给粮仓通电，这确实有效，但对农场工人来说非常糟糕，因为这太麻烦了，让工作变得困难得多。

sentences.en: And so then he heard about a local farmer whose son found a stray livestock guardian dog, like a Pyrenees-type dog, you know, that are often put out like with sheep to protect them
sentences.zh: 后来他听说当地有个农民，其儿子发现了一只流浪的牲畜护卫犬，就像比利牛斯山犬那种，你知道的，通常会被放出去和羊群待在一起保护它们，

sentences.en: from coyotes or whatever.
sentences.zh: 免受郊狼或其他动物的侵害。

sentences.en: And to everyone's surprise, this dog was chasing bears away, including like mother bears with cubs, grizzlies.
sentences.zh: 令所有人惊讶的是，这只狗竟然能赶走熊，包括带着幼崽的母熊，甚至是灰熊。

sentences.en: And so Wesley gets with this professor who studies livestock guardian dogs, and they decide to try this study where the dogs were not guarding livestock.
sentences.zh: 于是韦斯利找到了一位研究牲畜护卫犬的教授，他们决定尝试一项研究，让这些狗不再看护牲畜。

sentences.en: They were basically guarding people.
sentences.zh: 它们基本上是在保护人。

sentences.en: They were guarding the farMs.
sentences.zh: 它们在保护农场。

sentences.en: And they get these big breeds, these Turkish breeds, like Kangals and Anatolian shepherds.
sentences.zh: 他们找来了这些大型品种，比如土耳其品种，像坎高犬和安纳托利亚牧羊犬。

sentences.en: And they recruit farmers to participate in this little tiny study.
sentences.zh: 他们招募了一些农民参与这项小规模的研究。

sentences.en: And these dogs were just transformative for the farmers.
sentences.zh: 这些狗对农民来说简直是颠覆性的。

sentences.en: And like the beautiful thing about this story is that these dogs were protecting the people and they were protecting the bears.
sentences.zh: 这个故事最美妙的地方在于，这些狗既保护了人，也保护了熊。

sentences.en: Because if the bears are going to threaten people's lives and livelihoods, they're going to get themselves killed.
sentences.zh: 因为如果熊威胁到人们的生命和生计，它们自己最终也会被杀掉。

sentences.en: So the dogs were this tool for coexistence, and the families were really in love with the dogs.
sentences.zh: 所以这些狗成了共存的工具，而这些家庭真的非常喜爱这些狗。

sentences.en: And more than one farmer said the same thing, which was, this dog would lay down his life for me.
sentences.zh: 不止一位农民说过同样的话：这只狗愿意为我献出生命。

sentences.en: What was your takeaway from this whole experience in Montana and the solutions that these people had come up with?
sentences.zh: 你从蒙大拿州的整个经历以及这些人想出的解决方案中，得到了什么启示？

sentences.en: It was really striking how this little idea, you know, cooked up by this bear manager and
sentences.zh: 令人印象深刻的是，这个由熊类管理人员和

sentences.en: this professor ended up having these real results for these farmers and then started spreading to other farms because other farmers in the area were seeing how well it was working.
sentences.zh: 这位教授共同想出的小点子，最终为这些农民带来了实实在在的成果，并开始传播到其他农场，因为该地区的其他农民看到了它的效果有多好。

sentences.en: Huge reduction in bear visits.
sentences.zh: 熊的造访次数大幅减少。

sentences.en: And so all of a sudden they were getting dogs.
sentences.zh: 于是突然之间，他们都开始养狗了。

sentences.en: So that was one thing.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一方面。

sentences.en: And that sort of speaks to the whole series, right, is about how these ideas can spread.
sentences.zh: 这其实也呼应了整个系列的主题，对吧，就是关于这些想法是如何传播开来的。

sentences.en: The other thing specific to the grizzly bears is that they were really rediscovering this ancient knowledge, right?
sentences.zh: 关于灰熊的另一件特别的事情是，他们实际上是在重新发现这种古老的知识，对吧？

sentences.en: Wesley went into the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 韦斯利深入研究了整件事。

sentences.en: He saw less conflict between Native American communities and grizzlies, and he thought that maybe that had to do with all the dogs that kind of roam around on the reservation.
sentences.zh: 他发现美洲原住民社区与灰熊之间的冲突较少，他认为这可能与保护区周围游荡的那些狗有关。

sentences.en: And of course, he knew that in Europe and Asia, these large dogs hundreds of years ago were bred to chase bears, right?
sentences.zh: 当然，他也知道在欧洲和亚洲，几百年前这些大型犬就是为了驱赶熊而培育的，对吧？

sentences.en: And so he talked about how with the loss of these big predators like grizzly bears over the last couple hundred years, you know, we forgot about these methods of coexistence.
sentences.zh: 所以他谈到，随着过去几百年里灰熊等大型捕食者的消失，我们忘记了这些共存的方法。

sentences.en: And now as they're recovering, we're having to relearn these ancient practices that had been forgotten.
sentences.zh: 而现在，随着它们数量的恢复，我们不得不重新学习这些被遗忘的古老做法。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一——《Connections》。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢试着捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基，我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你们刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 即可开始游戏。

sentences.en: The two of you set yourselves up to find stories from all 50 states.
sentences.zh: 你们俩设定了目标，要从全美50个州寻找故事。

sentences.en: And I do wonder if, for any reason, some states were more challenging than others.
sentences.zh: 我确实想知道，是否有任何原因导致某些州比其他州更具挑战性。

sentences.en: Obviously, certain states, just legislatively, if not culturally, perhaps, are more or less focused on things like climate, on things like environment, on things like conservation.
sentences.zh: 显然，某些州在立法层面，如果不是在文化层面，对气候、环境、保护等问题的关注程度确实有所不同。

sentences.en: For example, I would imagine if you went to Portland, you would be quite easy to find somebody who would come up with a creative vegan solution to something.
sentences.zh: 例如，我想如果你去波特兰，很容易就能找到一个能为某事提出创意纯素解决方案的人。

sentences.en: By the way, I didn't even know before I read your story that there is such a thing as a vegan tattoo parlor.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，在读你们的故事之前，我甚至不知道还有纯素纹身店这种东西。

sentences.en: So that's a tease.
sentences.zh: 所以这只是个预告。

sentences.en: Anybody listening should just go read that story.
sentences.zh: 任何听众都应该去读读那个故事。

sentences.en: But I wonder, did you find areas of the country that were just harder to find folks who were talking about any of these issues that we've been discussing?
sentences.zh: 但我很好奇，你们是否发现国内有些地区很难找到愿意谈论我们一直在讨论的这些议题的人？

sentences.en: Yeah, Portland really boggles the mind in terms of its vegan offerings.
sentences.zh: 是的，波特兰在纯素产品方面确实让人大开眼界。

sentences.en: It's home to a vegan strip club.
sentences.zh: 那里有一家纯素脱衣舞俱乐部。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The dancers are not allowed wear leather or feathers.
sentences.zh: 舞者不允许穿皮草或羽毛制品。

sentences.en: I don't know if I'm going to say their motto.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该不该说出他们的座右铭。

sentences.en: It is saucy.
sentences.zh: 这很俏皮。

sentences.en: Say it.
sentences.zh: 说吧。

sentences.en: Tell it.
sentences.zh: 讲出来。

sentences.en: The motto is we put the meat on the pole, not on the plate.
sentences.zh: 座右铭是：我们把肉放在钢管上，而不是盘子里。

sentences.en: As I said, creative vegan solutions.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，有创意的纯素解决方案。

sentences.en: But some of the states were definitely harder than others.
sentences.zh: 但有些州确实比其他州更难。

sentences.en: And by the time we were working through the series, towards the end, we had covered so many
sentences.zh: 当我们完成这个系列的工作时，接近尾声时，我们已经涵盖了如此多

sentences.en: iterations of how to tackle climate and environmental crises that we didn't want to do repeats.
sentences.zh: 关于如何应对气候和环境危机的方案，我们不想重复。

sentences.en: And so there were challenges for sure.
sentences.zh: 所以确实存在挑战。

sentences.en: But one of our best stories, one of my favorite stories, came from North Dakota, which it was in our second last batch of stories.
sentences.zh: 但我们最好的故事之一，也是我最喜欢的故事之一，来自北达科他州，那是在我们倒数第二批故事中。

sentences.en: And my colleague, Sachi Mulkey, found a beautiful story there.
sentences.zh: 我的同事萨奇·马尔基在那里发现了一个美丽的故事。

sentences.en: She found that the Standing Rock tribe was deep in an effort to get EV chargers set up throughout tribal lands.
sentences.zh: 她发现立岩部落正深入致力于在整个部落土地上安装电动汽车充电桩。

sentences.en: And just remind us quickly, Standing Rock, we all know that name because?
sentences.zh: 顺便提醒我们一下，立岩，我们都知道这个名字是因为？

sentences.en: Because of the Dakota Access pipeline protests, which were national, international news.
sentences.zh: 因为达科他输油管道抗议活动，那是全国乃至国际性的新闻。

sentences.en: They were trying to stop a pipeline from going through their land.
sentences.zh: 他们试图阻止输油管道穿过他们的土地。

sentences.en: And they had been trying for years as well, concurrent to that, to get off fossil fuels in their tribal lands by embracing all these clean energy projects.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，多年来他们也一直试图通过拥抱所有这些清洁能源项目，在部落土地上摆脱化石燃料。

sentences.en: And more recently, they've been putting up EV chargers so you can drive.
sentences.zh: 最近，他们一直在安装电动汽车充电桩，这样你就可以开车了。

sentences.en: It's part of an inter-tribal network.
sentences.zh: 这是部落间网络的一部分。

sentences.en: So you can drive electric vehicles without ever having to gas up as you drive through tribal lands.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以在穿越部落土地时驾驶电动汽车，而无需加油。

sentences.en: I would imagine that installing electric vehicle chargers is not an inexpensive project, especially, if I'm not mistaken, the Standing Rock Reservation, that is in an area where
sentences.zh: 我想安装电动汽车充电桩不是一个便宜的项目，特别是如果我没记错的话，立岩保留地位于一个

sentences.en: there's a lot of poverty, right?
sentences.zh: 贫困程度很高的地区，对吧？

sentences.en: That was one of the issues with the Dakota Access pipeline is it was cutting through this already sort of vulnerable area.
sentences.zh: 这也是达科他输油管道的问题之一，因为它穿过了这个本已脆弱的地区。

sentences.en: Where did they get the money for this project?
sentences.zh: 他们从哪里弄到这个项目的资金的？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Well, one major source, it was the Department of Energy grants.
sentences.zh: 嗯，一个主要的来源是能源部的拨款。

sentences.en: They won a $6 million grant to help fund this effort.
sentences.zh: 他们赢得了600万美元的拨款来资助这项工作。

sentences.en: So that made this possible.
sentences.zh: 所以这使得项目成为可能。

sentences.en: And as we spoke about at the beginning of this conversation, however, federal money, federal initiatives for environment and climate are going away or being dismantled.
sentences.zh: 然而，正如我们在对话开始时所谈到的，联邦资金、联邦环境和气候倡议正在消失或被拆解。

sentences.en: So I just sort of wonder, how does that affect programs like this in the future?
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，这在未来会如何影响这类项目？

sentences.en: Yeah, a lot of them are having to put things on hold.
sentences.zh: 是的，很多项目不得不暂停。

sentences.en: You know, so in Fayetteville, Arkansas, where they've reduced methane emissions from the landfill through composting, they had two $20 million climate resilience projects they had
sentences.zh: 你知道，在阿肯色州的费耶特维尔，他们通过堆肥减少了垃圾填埋场的甲烷排放，但他们有两个2000万美元的气候适应项目不得不

sentences.en: to shelve.
sentences.zh: 搁置。

sentences.en: But on the flip side, cities are looking at things that are under their purview where they can save a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，城市正在关注那些在他们职权范围内可以节省大量资金的事情。

sentences.en: And that was the case in Pittsburgh when it decided to tackle light pollution.
sentences.zh: 匹兹堡在决定解决光污染问题时就是这种情况。

sentences.en: Light pollution, a type of pollution that I wonder how many people actually think of as real pollution.
sentences.zh: 光污染，一种我怀疑有多少人真正认为它是真正污染的污染类型。

sentences.en: People don't think of it as real pollution, but according to a 2023 study, it's growing globally at 10% a year.
sentences.zh: 人们不认为它是真正的污染，但根据2023年的一项研究，它在全球范围内以每年10%的速度增长。

sentences.en: Many places are overlit.
sentences.zh: 许多地方光照过度。

sentences.en: But, you know, we know that we're not supposed to have exposure to blue light at night, like we're staring at our computer screens.
sentences.zh: 但是，我们知道晚上不应该接触蓝光，就像我们盯着电脑屏幕那样。

sentences.en: We know...
sentences.zh: 我们知道……

sentences.en: Yes, we know that, but we don't do it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们知道，但我们还是会这样做。

sentences.en: We know it, we don't do it, but we know it's having impact on our melatonin levels.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，我们不这样做，但我们知道它对我们的褪黑素水平有影响。

sentences.en: It's not just impacting us.
sentences.zh: 它不仅影响我们。

sentences.en: It's impacting pollinator-friendly species and birds and bats.
sentences.zh: 它还影响传粉友好型物种、鸟类和蝙蝠。

sentences.en: It's also interfering as global light grows.
sentences.zh: 随着全球光照的增加，它也在干扰。

sentences.en: It's interfering with processes in the atmosphere that actually clean the air, that need nighttime darkness, according to a study, to literally filter out the pollution.
sentences.zh: 它干扰了大气中实际清洁空气的过程，根据一项研究，这些过程需要夜间的黑暗来真正过滤掉污染。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We're also using a ton of energy doing it.
sentences.zh: 我们这样做也消耗了大量的能源。

sentences.en: And so in Pittsburgh, an astronomy professor there, she wanted her students to see the dark skies at night.
sentences.zh: 所以在匹兹堡，一位天文学教授希望她的学生能看到夜晚黑暗的天空。

sentences.en: And she had been agitating, trying to raise awareness about the benefits of dimmer, softer lights.
sentences.zh: 她一直在奔走呼吁，试图提高人们对更暗、更柔和灯光好处的认识。

sentences.en: So what did they come up with?
sentences.zh: 那么他们想出了什么办法？

sentences.en: So they came up with dimmable streetlights that certain city officials can dim from their phones.
sentences.zh: 他们想出了可调光的路灯，特定的城市官员可以用手机调暗它们。

sentences.en: Like you can just swipe across your phone if you're a city official and turn down the intensity of streetlights at night.
sentences.zh: 就像如果你是城市官员，你只需在手机上滑动一下，就能调低夜间路灯的亮度。

sentences.en: They also designed streetlights that have hoods over them.
sentences.zh: 他们还设计了带有灯罩的路灯。

sentences.en: So instead of the light glaring upwards, where it can disorient birds and other flying animals, they're hooded and just direct the light down.
sentences.zh: 所以光线不会向上刺眼，从而使鸟类和其他飞行生物迷失方向，它们被遮住并直接向下照射。

sentences.en: And they also save money.
sentences.zh: 而且它们还能省钱。

sentences.en: The city projects that it'll save $942,000 in energy costs a year.
sentences.zh: 该市预计每年可节省94.2万美元的能源成本。

sentences.en: And it'll prevent 12,000 metric tons of carbon dioxide emissions each year.
sentences.zh: 并且每年将减少1.2万公吨的二氧化碳排放。

sentences.en: One thing that's really striking me listening to these stories also is that we have not talked about politics once.
sentences.zh: 听这些故事时，有一点让我印象深刻，那就是我们一次都没有谈到政治。

sentences.en: These do not seem like political problems or politicized solutions.
sentences.zh: 这些看起来不像政治问题，也不像政治化的解决方案。

sentences.en: These seem like people in their communities trying to figure out how do I deal with a problem that is affecting me specifically.
sentences.zh: 这些看起来像是社区里的人们试图弄清楚如何处理一个具体影响到我的问题。

sentences.en: And I would imagine, though, that the folks you talked to, I mean, again, you went to all
sentences.zh: 不过我想，你交谈过的人，我的意思是，再次强调，你去了所有

sentences.en: 50 states.
sentences.zh: 50个州。

sentences.en: You probably encountered folks who all come from very different perspectives and starting points.
sentences.zh: 你可能遇到了来自非常不同视角和起点的人。

sentences.en: So I just sort of wonder what, if anything, there is to say about the politics of reporting on this.
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，关于报道这些内容的政治性，有什么可说的吗？

sentences.en: I'm going to jump in with an example.
sentences.zh: 我想举个例子。

sentences.en: Oklahoma has restored more streams than any other state.
sentences.zh: 俄克拉荷马州修复的河流比其他任何州都多。

sentences.en: And part of the reason they're able to do that is they were able to convince farmers, especially beef farmers, keep your cows out of the streaMs.
sentences.zh: 他们能够做到这一点，部分原因是他们能够说服农民，特别是肉牛养殖户：让你的牛远离河流。

sentences.en: Fence off your cows.
sentences.zh: 把你的牛围起来。

sentences.en: So this farmer that had done this, he found that because his cows weren't drinking crappy
sentences.zh: 所以这个这样做的农民发现，因为他的牛不再喝糟糕的

sentences.en: water, they were putting on more weight.
sentences.zh: 水，它们的体重增加了。

sentences.en: His vet bills were going down.
sentences.zh: 他的兽医账单减少了。

sentences.en: And they were also, because they weren't slip sliding up and down the bank, the whole bank had come back to life with wildlife.
sentences.zh: 而且，因为它们不会在河岸上滑来滑去，整个河岸又恢复了生机，充满了野生动物。

sentences.en: Bald eagles were nesting.
sentences.zh: 秃鹰在那里筑巢。

sentences.en: We didn't talk about politics once.
sentences.zh: 我们一次都没谈到政治。

sentences.en: He was talking about doing things that helped his bottom line, helped his cows be healthier, and helped nature in the same token.
sentences.zh: 他谈论的是做那些有助于他底线、帮助他的牛更健康，同时也能帮助自然的事情。

sentences.en: It was almost like in a lot of our reporting, I'm not going to say it transcended politics, but people want clean air.
sentences.zh: 这几乎就像我们在很多报道中所做的那样，我不会说它超越了政治，但人们想要清洁的空气。

sentences.en: They want clean water.
sentences.zh: 他们想要清洁的水。

sentences.en: They want beauty around them.
sentences.zh: 他们想要周围的美景。

sentences.en: And that was like a through line we found in every single state we reported on.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在报道的每一个州都发现的一条主线。

sentences.en: I do sort of wonder, like, maybe there was no question in the communities that you visited about what the problem was, but I can imagine that maybe there was debate about what the
sentences.zh: 我确实很好奇，也许你们访问的社区对问题是什么没有疑问，但我可以想象，也许对于原因是什么存在争论，特别是在涉及气候方面时。

sentences.en: cause was, especially as it related to climate.
sentences.zh: 这在多大程度上影响了你们的对话，或者甚至，事情的原因在多大程度上影响了人们为自己想出的解决方案？

sentences.en: And how much did that factor into your conversations or even, like, how much did the cause of things affect the solutions that people were coming up with for themselves?
sentences.zh: 我确实认为值得指出的是，有时人们不想谈论气候变化。

sentences.en: I do think it's worth pointing out that sometimes people didn't want to talk about climate change.
sentences.zh: 就像，有时我采访人们时，他们甚至害怕使用“气候变化”这个词。

sentences.en: Like, they almost felt sometimes I'd be interviewing people and they'd be scared to even use the term climate change.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，农民和牧场主经常经历气候变化，但他们要么不想用那个词，要么绝对不想谈论它

sentences.en: And, you know, farmers and ranchers often are experiencing climate change, but they either don't want to use that word or they definitely don't want to talk about it
sentences.zh: 是人为造成的。

sentences.en: as human-caused.
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 因为它被政治化了。

sentences.en: Because it's been politicized.
sentences.zh: 因为他们不想在社区里受到反弹，或者因为他们不相信，或者像——

sentences.en: Because they didn't want blowback in their communities or because they didn't believe it or, like—
sentences.zh: 我想是综合原因。

sentences.en: A combo, I think.
sentences.zh: 是的，好吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, okay.
sentences.zh: 而且有些人不想和我们交谈。

sentences.en: And there were people who didn't want to talk to us.
sentences.zh: 我们原本有一个非常喜欢的故事。

sentences.en: We had one story lined up that we really loved.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很想讲述它。

sentences.en: We really wanted to tell it.
sentences.zh: 然后他们私下讨论后说，我们真的很害怕谈论它，因为我们不想让联邦政府

sentences.en: And then they talked amongst themselves and they said, we're really scared of, you know, talking about it because we don't want the federal government
sentences.zh: 来找我们的麻烦，因为我们在谈论气候，而且因为我们确实从联邦政府那里得到了一些资助，我们不想危及它。

sentences.en: to come after us because we're talking about climate and because we did get some funding from the federal government and we don't want to imperil it.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这很微妙。

sentences.en: So, you know, it was nuanced.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这很微妙。

sentences.en: It was complicated oftentimes on the ground.
sentences.zh: 在实地工作中，情况往往很复杂。

sentences.en: I wonder if your outlook on the future has changed after spending so much time with people who have been thinking about fixes at this hyper-local level.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，在与那些致力于在超本地层面寻求解决方案的人们相处了这么久之后，你对未来的看法是否有所改变？

sentences.en: Like, how are you looking at sort of the broader, bigger, holistic problems that the country or the planet faces?
sentences.zh: 比如，你是如何看待国家或地球所面临的那些更广泛、更宏大、更整体的问题的？

sentences.en: Yeah, for me, the answer is really two-pronged.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对我来说，答案其实是双管齐下的。

sentences.en: The big picture is very scary, as the big picture often is.
sentences.zh: 大局确实非常令人担忧，大局往往如此。

sentences.en: I mean, the crises we're facing, they're real, they're mounting, they're hitting some people disproportionately compared to others.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们面临的危机是真实存在的，而且正在加剧，对某些人造成的影响远比对其他人严重。

sentences.en: But then on the local level, as we reported out these stories, as I was seeing all the different ways communities were tackling different aspects of climate change, I couldn't help
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，在基层，当我们报道这些故事时，当我看到社区以各种不同方式应对气候变化的不同方面时，我不禁

sentences.en: but feel a little bit hopeful.
sentences.zh: 感到了一丝希望。

sentences.en: Like, there are so many people all over the country that are finding ways to work with the planet rather than against it.
sentences.zh: 因为全国各地有那么多人正在寻找与地球和谐共处，而不是与之对抗的方法。

sentences.en: Katrin, you?
sentences.zh: 卡特琳，你呢？

sentences.en: It is really meaningful to spend time with people who are working so hard to make their communities better.
sentences.zh: 与那些如此努力改善社区的人们共度时光，真的非常有意义。

sentences.en: And I really enjoyed that personally.
sentences.zh: 我个人非常享受这段经历。

sentences.en: But like, in a broader way, it makes me think of something that Jane Goodall, you know, the
sentences.zh: 但从更广阔的角度来看，这让我想起了珍·古道尔（Jane Goodall）——你知道，那位

sentences.en: famous primatologist and environmentalist who died in October, something that she emphasized
sentences.zh: 著名的灵长类动物学家和环保主义者，她于十月去世——她所强调的一件事，

sentences.en: a lot, especially toward the end of her life, was that like, every single day that we live, we are making a difference.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在她生命的最后阶段，那就是：我们活着的每一天，都在产生影响。

sentences.en: Our actions are making a difference.
sentences.zh: 我们的行动正在产生影响。

sentences.en: And we get to decide what kind of difference we make.
sentences.zh: 而我们可以决定自己产生什么样的影响。

sentences.en: And the people that we interviewed this year for the series just embodied that.
sentences.zh: 我们今年为这个系列节目采访的人们，恰恰体现了这一点。

sentences.en: These people were really living in that spirit.
sentences.zh: 这些人确实活出了那种精神。

sentences.en: Kara Buckley, Katrin Einhorn, thank you both so much for being here.
sentences.zh: 卡拉·巴克利（Kara Buckley）、卡特琳·艾因霍恩（Katrin Einhorn），非常感谢你们二位来到这里。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Zoran Mamdani was sworn in as mayor of New York City just after midnight on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 周四午夜刚过，佐兰·马姆达尼（Zoran Mamdani）宣誓就任纽约市市长。

sentences.en: In his inauguration speech, he vowed to represent all New Yorkers, even the ones who may view his administration with, quote, distrust or disdain.
sentences.zh: 在就职演说中，他誓言要代表所有纽约人，即使是那些可能对他执政持“不信任或蔑视”态度的市民。

sentences.en: If you are a New Yorker, I am your mayor.
sentences.zh: 如果你是纽约人，我就是你的市长。

sentences.en: Regardless of whether we agree, I will protect you, celebrate with you.
sentences.zh: 无论我们是否意见一致，我都会保护你，与你共同庆祝。

sentences.en: Mourn alongside you.
sentences.zh: 与你一同哀悼。

sentences.en: And never, not for a second, hide from you.
sentences.zh: 并且永远，哪怕一秒钟，都不会躲避你。

sentences.en: The speech was peppered with references to the working-class New Yorkers who helped drive
sentences.zh: 演讲中多次提到那些帮助马姆达尼入主市政厅的

sentences.en: Mamdani to City Hall.
sentences.zh: 纽约工人阶级。

sentences.en: The mayor called out people who drive taxis, clean public parks, and serve, as he put it, biryani and beef patties.
sentences.zh: 市长特别提到了那些开出租车、清洁公共公园，以及正如他所说，供应印度香饭和牛肉饼的人们。

sentences.en: While Mamdani has spent months reassuring civic and business leaders of his pragmatism, he pledged to govern as a democratic socialist, vowing to run the city, quote, expansively
sentences.zh: 尽管马姆达尼花了几个月时间向公民和商业领袖保证他的务实态度，但他承诺将以民主社会主义者的身份执政，誓言要以“广阔”

sentences.en: and audaciously.
sentences.zh: 和“大胆”的方式管理这座城市。

sentences.en: To those who insist that the era of big government is over, hear me when I say this.
sentences.zh: 对于那些坚持认为大政府时代已经结束的人，请听我说：

sentences.en: No longer will City Hall hesitate to use its power to improve New Yorkers' lives.
sentences.zh: 市政厅将不再犹豫，会利用其权力改善纽约人的生活。

sentences.en: And Tatiana Schlossberg, an environmental journalist and a daughter of Caroline Kennedy, died on
sentences.zh: 此外，环境记者、卡罗琳·肯尼迪（Caroline Kennedy）的女儿塔蒂亚娜·施洛斯伯格（Tatiana Schlossberg）于

sentences.en: Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 周二去世。

sentences.en: Tatiana received a wave of attention recently for a powerful essay she published in The New
sentences.zh: 塔蒂亚娜最近因她在《纽约客》上发表的一篇震撼人心的文章而备受关注，

sentences.en: Yorker about how she was diagnosed with leukemia right after giving birth to her daughter.
sentences.zh: 文章讲述了她在生下女儿后被诊断出患有白血病的过程。

sentences.en: The essay was about her battle with a rare form of the illness, and also about her alarm at the changing healthcare landscape for Americans.
sentences.zh: 这篇文章讲述了她与这种罕见疾病的抗争，也表达了她对美国医疗环境不断变化所感到的担忧。

sentences.en: But it was also very personal.
sentences.zh: 但它也非常个人化。

sentences.en: It was about dying, and it was about parenting and memory.
sentences.zh: 它关乎死亡，也关乎为人父母和记忆。

sentences.en: Some of us had the pleasure of working with Tatiana when she was a reporter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我们中的一些人曾有幸在塔蒂亚娜担任《纽约时报》记者时与她共事。

sentences.en: And this week, colleagues have been sharing their own memories.
sentences.zh: 本周，同事们纷纷分享了他们对她的回忆。

sentences.en: How hard she worked, her intelligence and poise, and also that she was very funny.
sentences.zh: 回忆她工作有多努力，她的智慧和从容，以及她其实非常幽默。
